title: Maximum Subarray
contract: Return the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray. Input is nonempty; sums use long.
reasoning: Enumerate starts and incrementally extend each end; a third summation loop is unnecessary.
Any best subarray ending at i either begins at i or extends the best subarray ending at i−1.
Track a separate global maximum. Initializing to zero would incorrectly choose an empty interval for all-negative input.
